libs.note: BH-6897: bin/ci-local.sh runs the CI lint job's steps ("Syntax + shellcheck + config integrity", "Test determinism lint") and the rules pack on a tree. The build's pre-PR gate (bin/lib/prepr-gate.sh), bin/blocked-resolver.sh fix rounds and bin/lead-review.sh call it through this lib. tests/ci-local-gates.bh-6897-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: 1 = the pre-PR gate, the resolver fix round and the lead review run bin/ci-local.sh, and a red step is a fix (pre-PR), a refused push (resolver) or a BLOCK (lead). 0 = off: no caller runs it and each records `off`. Any other answer is this default. Read by bin/lib/ci-local-verify.sh with no literal.
Wall-clock seconds for one whole bin/ci-local.sh run. A step that runs past it is COULD-NOT-RUN, never red. 900 covers a cold shellcheck of the whole tree on a shared vCPU (BH-1200).
